description: CR 109.5/603.3a the control: ALICE loses the life, and her own Exquisite Blood stays silent
note: The control twin for Sign in Blood, differing in ONE thing: the spell targets alice, so she is the one who loses. Same card, same 2 life, same life-loss event, and "an opponent" is bob, so Exquisite Blood stays silent. alice's loss is checked too, or the case would pass for the wrong reason: an engine that recorded no loss would also show no gain. Both players have library cards so Sign in Blood's draw cannot end the game before the trigger could resolve.
